tim_relation.source_boundary: Roles and traits are archival descriptions of how the figure appears in old sources. Motive, diagnosis, criminality, and permanent moral essence are not inferred from the old profile prose.

presence.rule: First/last currently recovered dated evidence in this dossier; not lifetime endpoints.

debt_and_repair.rule: Do not attach legal, financial, karmic or spiritual debt unless a dated source explicitly does so; symbolic debt remains project language unless independently established.

cia_record.state_rule: Roles, archetypes, upgrades, handicaps and project-symbolic placements are date/source-bounded states, not permanent human essences.
